# VYRO

Website: https://vyrodesk.com/

VYRO is an AI desktop companion for Windows.

## Key features

- Voice commands
- Open apps
- Focus mode
- AI emotions/reactions
- Desktop assistance

## Operating systems

- Windows 10
- Windows 11

## Price

- $19 one-time lifetime license

## Privacy and security summary

- VYRO is designed to be user-controlled.
- Microphone access is used for voice commands.
- Users remain in control of permissions.
- Full privacy details are available at https://vyrodesk.com/privacy.
